response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage) AS mean_above_average FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage;
